reason: Add a synthetic administrative Today overview across every authorized clinic. Per-clinic local-day appointment totals and all-date active queues come from full scoped SQL populations, with independent bounded source pages. Current verified dashboard/appointment grants, patient-name redaction, exact source context and immutable history protect links. All-or-none generations/abort and authority revalidation clear obsolete multi-clinic reads. Shared presentation owns complete optional overview tables; app adapters own all queries, windows, permissions and commands. No financial/clinical metrics or provider delivery is enabled. Current appointment details are resolved only from a fresh authorized source page; complete historical data loads separately and retains every-clinic permission checks.
